ControlPanel_Debug_Logging.name: Enable Debug Logging
ControlPanel_Debug_Logging.tooltip: Show detailed debug logs in the browser console during manager operations

ControlPanel_Manager_Repository_Data_Ove.name: Replace Manager Repository Data
ControlPanel_Manager_Repository_Data_Ove.tooltip: Use ControlPanel's cached Manager repository data and force ComfyUI Manager offline channel settings

ControlPanel_Manager_Repository_Data_Cha.name: Manager Repository Data Source
ControlPanel_Manager_Repository_Data_Cha.tooltip: Choose where ControlPanel fetches ComfyUI Manager repository data

ControlPanel_Allow_Flagged_Version_As_La.name: Use flagged version as latest
ControlPanel_Allow_Flagged_Version_As_La.tooltip: Include newer cached Flagged versions in Updates Available and use them as the latest install and update targets in Nodes Manager and Manager exports. Registry status and Manager installation policy are preserved.

ControlPanel_Update_ComfyUI_Nightly.name: Use Nightly for ComfyUI updates
ControlPanel_Update_ComfyUI_Nightly.tooltip: When enabled, Update ComfyUI uses git default branch instead of latest release.
